releases.title: Smoother play and a proper start
notes: The game runs more smoothly, with a steadier frame rate in busy scenes.
Your character loads in properly, stands on the ground, and is sized correctly.
Running and jumping feel more responsive and consistent.
The tutorial and the day display now appear when you start a brand-new game.
Bedrooms have a soft light at night, so they're easier to see in.

releases.title: Storm gliding and a friendlier start
notes: You can now ride the storm, gliding on the wind across rooftops.
New players get a short tutorial the first time they play.
Touch controls and layout feel smoother on phones.
There's now a What's new section on the website so you can see what's changed.

releases.title: Smoother camera on the commute
notes: The camera now finds the car straight away at the start of each drive.
During the commute, the camera stays on the person instead of showing the car park interior.
The camera no longer swings into buildings beside the road while driving.

releases.title: A whole day, as it happens
notes: Follow AI through one full day in real time, from waking up to lights out.
Every action of the day plays out in the room as the clock moves.
